items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: All I know is Hanks and Yanks.

ctx.x: Vermilla, maybe? Oh, okay. I don't know him. Do you know a trombone player from Algiers named Joe? Joe? The trombone player from Algiers named Joe?
Joe? Maybe we called him something else. All I know is Hanks and Yanks. That's all the true trombone player. Buddy?
